text.description_html:
Acorn AT8BR, Black Iron Old World Heart Rim Latch Set

A window into the art and history of a time when all ironwork was done by hand, Acorn's Heart Rim Latch Set is inspired by old world. It made out of iron and finished in a smooth matte black for an authentic look. Good for 7/8" to 1-3/4" door thicknesses. The Black Iron Old World Heart Rim Latch Set comes with a heart tip handle that is good both exterior and the interior use and an easy flip down locking device for privacy. Reversible for right or left handing and comes with reverse bevel so it will work on doors that open in or out.

Smooth Black Iron: With a flat black appearance, smooth iron exemplifies the hardware as it was originally forged.

Also available Rough Black Iron Heart Rim Latch Set

Specifications: of the Old World Heart Rim Latch Set:

  • Passage door handle for hall side of door
  • Reverse bevel / closet door handle for room side or exterior of storm door
  • Includes all necessary hardware.
  • Field reservable.
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty!

Features of the Rim Latch Set:

  • Finish: Smooth Black Iron
  • Handle Height: 8-3/4"
  • Handle Width: 2-1/4"
  • Projection: 1-1/2"
  • Door Thickness: 7/8" to 1 3/4"

Sold as a set.
